mechanism: Abnormally strong signed trailing 24-hour returns may persist over the following UTC day when slower market participants and liquidity providers adjust to large crypto price moves.
cost_assumptions: Contract CRYPTO_PERPS_1H_V2: 4 bps taker plus 2 bps modeled slippage each side, mandatory next-bar fill, funding at 8-hour settlement; no execution qualification inferred.
falsification_criteria: At Stage 1, reject if Warden family rules_ts default profit-factor, market-time or edge-to-cost conjunct fails; never lower Warden gates.

One frozen base rule: at 00:00 UTC, normalize completed trailing 24h close return by previous 720 hourly observations of 24h rolling-return standard deviation, enter same direction only when abs(z) >= 2.0; hold till next UTC day; gross exposure capped 1.0, per-asset cap 0.25.
No parameter search or subsequent revisions in this test; any failed screen is recorded as a negative result.
